svg.text: Scan only the approved practice app
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Your existing Nessus scanner · private VMware network
Use the Nessus classes to create a scan scoped only to APP01’s recorded private address.
Resolve helpdesk.lab.example.test through your lab DNS; do not scan the public lab.example.test
Set a light practice scan, record permission/scope, and compare findings with the installed
versions and actual settings. Keep availability checks and backup ready.
Fix one verified issue, repeat the same scan and test ticket creation. A clean scan alone does
not prove the application is secure. Nessus on Windows uses its own service, not IIS.
Check: The scan scope is private APP01, findings are reviewed, and the app still works
